meta.title: Build your map
meta.description: Two minutes to see what matters at your stage of pregnancy, who can help, and your next step. MILA’S, MAPS for parenthood.
meta.keywords: pregnancy, maternity, Bengaluru, St. Philomena’s, MILA’S, MAPS

intro: Start at home. Each answer adds a place to your map. At the end you keep the map and your three next stops.

text: First place on the map: your doctor. Roughly how far along are you? A guess is fine.
clinic-pregnant.description: A road appears and she walks from home to a small clinic.

text: First place on the map: a doctor. Most of what shapes a first pregnancy is decided in the first weeks, often before anyone has told the family.
clinic-trying.description: A road appears and she walks from home to a small clinic.

text: Congratulations. First place on the map: the baby’s doctor. How old is your baby?
clinic-baby.description: A road appears and she walks from home to a small clinic, carrying the baby.

text: Do you have a doctor you see regularly?
doctor.description: She waits at the clinic door.

text: Good. Your doctor makes every medical decision. MILA’S helps with everything around it: costs, paperwork, what to ask at the next visit.
Next place: where will the baby arrive?
doctor-yes.description: The doctor steps out of the clinic.

text: That is the first thing to sort out, and we can help you choose one. Your doctor makes every medical decision. MILA’S handles everything around it.
Next place: where will the baby arrive?
doctor-no.description: A question mark appears over the clinic door.

text: St. Philomena’s is on your map. A full delivery package at the J Ward is ₹1,56,000 all in. Anything beyond the standard stay is charged at room rates, shown before admission.
Which room would you pick?
hosp-stp.description: The road turns and St. Philomena’s hospital rises beside it.

text: Your hospital is on the map. Ask them for a written estimate for the package you want, and what is charged on top. We read it with you.
Which room would you pick?
hosp-other.description: The road turns and a hospital rises beside it.

text: No hurry. We hold a space on the map for it. At St. Philomena’s the J Ward delivery package is ₹1,56,000 all in, and we can walk you through the ward before you decide.
If you had to pick a room today?
hosp-undecided.description: The road turns and a dotted outline marks where the hospital will go.

text: General ward, noted on the map. The lowest bill and the busiest ward.
Does your health insurance cover the delivery?
room-general.description: A room tag appears on the hospital.

text: Single AC room, noted on the map. Room rent is the number insurers look at first, so keep it handy.
Does your health insurance cover the delivery?
room-single.description: A room tag appears on the hospital.

text: Deluxe room, noted on the map. Comfortable, and the one most likely to cross a policy’s room rent limit.
Does your health insurance cover the delivery?
room-deluxe.description: A room tag appears on the hospital.

text: Covered. One check before admission: if your room costs more than the policy’s room rent limit, the insurer can pay less on the whole bill, not just the room.
Last place. Who is travelling with you?
ins-yes.description: The insurance office appears with a green tick.

text: No cover, so the bill is yours. That makes the written estimate and the room choice the two numbers that matter most. We plan around them with you.
Last place. Who is travelling with you?
ins-no.description: The insurance office appears, marked not covered.

text: Most people are not sure. Send us the policy and we find the maternity cover, the waiting period and the room rent limit for you.
Last place. Who is travelling with you?
ins-unsure.description: The insurance office appears with a question mark.

text: Your partner is waiting at home. Bring them to the next appointment and the Meet Mila call, so two people hear everything.
fam-partner.description: The road comes back home and her partner waits at the door.

text: Your mother is waiting at home. She has done this before, and the hospital has changed since. We brief you both.
fam-mother.description: The road comes back home and her mother waits at the door.

text: A full house. Pick one person to hold the paperwork and one to hold the phone, and the hospital days get easier.
fam-both.description: The road comes back home and the family waits at the door.

text: Then Mila walks with you. One number to message, one person who knows your map.

end.description: The map pulls back to show the whole route, home to home.

ending.title: This is your map.
ending.consent: I’m happy for MILA’S to message me about my map. My answers are used only for this.
ending.button: Send me my map on WhatsApp
ending.after: Your map is on its way. Someone from the team will reply during working hours. A message is not a booking until the team confirms one with you.
